metadata.evidence: Given any query nodes, Community Search aims to find a densely connected subgraph containing query nodes.
metadata.reason: Defines the central task addressed by the artifact.

metadata.evidence: we propose a query-driven Temporal Graph Convolutional Network (CS-TGN)
metadata.reason: Names the proposed model and its methodological category.

metadata.value: CS-TGN first combines the local query-dependent structure and the global graph embedding in each snapshot of the network and then uses a GRU cell with contextual attention to learn the dynamics of interactions and update node embeddings over time.
